author: NotPineapple203
body:
Before June 7th (I think) 2016, the last time I had played minecraft was December 31, 2014. My family said I had a problem and my school grades were starting to noticeably drop. I was playing around 6 hours a day on break and 1-2 hours on school nights. Then as my new year's resolution, I quit. Just like that. and It stayed like that for 17 months. I stopped making the map I had been working on, however it was continued by a friend (Still rejected ;-;). Then after hearing my map was rejected I came on to see what my next one would be up against. I noticed many maps were simply simulations of land with custom trees and maybe a few buildings (Crusade esque). All of them looked about the same. A sliver of land shaped like VVV
team a-----------\                                                                                                                              /-------------team b----------
                                   \                                                                                                                           /
                                    |                                                                                                                        /
                                    |                                                                                                                       |              STONE... NOTHING
                                    \                                                                                                                      |              ELSE... JUST STONE
                                      \                                                                                                                   /
                                        \                                                                                                                /
                                         \ _____________water or valley__________________________/


And I tried playing some and the gameplay seemed stale. You HAD to cross the valley, you HAD to expose yourself. And often enough, the game would end within 10 - 15 minutes. Now YES there are some great maps that are like that but there are many that are just like the rest. 


I have been playing since mczone was a thing and i still remember playing ternio and thinking it was the greatest map ever.
And I miss the maps like that. Flat. Simple. Not Strangling your fps. many angles of attack. games that last sometimes hours.
But funny enough... those are somethings that map devs and others turn peoples maps down for. 

"It's a little flat. Try varying the altitude."

"The ground is very simple. Try mixing in another block"

"It needs more detail. Add water too!"

"It seems like it will be stalematish"

But the funny thing is, ternio, rendezvous, frostbite, and all these other maps are exactly like that. And those are the maps that many people love. More often than not the biggest TDM server will be, You guessed it, THROWBACK. And It's for this reason that I think that we should start bringing back themes that are frowned upon. And this reason that Map devs should give some maps a chance.

But still some maps will just absolutely suck!

 cough cherryland MC cough

So your map was denied and you are pointing out that throwback maps are terrible.

Some tips for the future. Make your point clear, put more facts and have more knowledge about things, you are mistaken on a few things and please do not make that picture on your thread with the slashes, it turned me off of reading more.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
>But still some maps will just absolutely suck!
>cough cherryland MC cough

So you made a point about a map format that is poor, and you praise throwback for its player count and neat map design concepts, but you say that Cherryland sucks when it does not follow that format and it is on throwback? That kinda was out of nowhere.

Anyway, the same map format gets kind of old. There's different metas on the network for different maps: one of them happens to be like Ravanged or Fissura: at least it's diversity. We shouldn't just throw on to another meta to allow flat and stalemate maps like some Throwback ones currently are, because that makes it less unique and of a meta. Take the island map trend: Broken World, WaterWerks, Honeycomb. There's always going to be different styles of maps & trends, it's a part of the server. I don't think we're going to remove maps just because they're laid out in a certain way.

replies.body: Throwback is for maps that were pre-avicore. We kept it due to nostalgia. There are 30 maps in that rotation that look exactly the same (luar, quintus, Ternio). We want more unique maps. We don't want copy's of what we have played for he past 4 years. We want new and special maps that actually are different in their own way

replies.body: Exactly. I'm not saying that we want to copy the old maps. I'm saying that we should incorporate themes brought up from them. Because isn't that what everyone comes back for? The older maps? Because as of me writing this, Throwback is the only DTM lobby with more than one person. So what I'm encouraging is to not copy from old maps but make them have the same simplistic feel.

replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body:
I was only using Cherryland as an example and partial joke because it's a very... debatable map. And there are many maps that I dislike that are on Throwback, and Cherryland MC is just one of the few.

And I'm not saying just make rendezvous a little different over and over again. I'm saying we should keep some themes shown in the more loved throwback maps, while still keeping them away from stalemate and stale gameplay. Such themes would be like, simple color palettes, plain floors, and simplistic map shape. And I also see many map devs and map critiques say that "Oh this map would be stalemate". But stalemate is often needed to prevent the game from lasting only 5-10 minutes. So what I feel is that we need to learn to make a map that has Throwback aesthetic and some of its Stalemate. Because once we learn the green zone of amount of stalemate needed then we could make the map have an ideal playing time 15-25 minutes.
